from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single legal judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document as it appears in the text")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) explicitly stated or defined in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    extracted_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
